content: You will be given an argumentation and asked about to find the relation from relation types: sup (support), exa (support by example), add (additional source), reb (rebutting attack), und (undercutting attack), joint (joining relation) between two selected argument components from it.

The statutory health insurance companies should also cover treatments with non-medical and alternative practitioners. Their treatment methods and successes are not amply researched or proven. Yet many patients subjectively experience relief or are cured of their complaints, which ultimately also saves costs for conventional treatments and medication. Also conventional medicine is in many cases not successful, and, moreover, entails significant risks and side effects.
What is the relation between "and, moreover, entails significant risks and side effects." and "Yet many patients subjectively experience relief or are cured of their complaints," from the above essay? Choose from following options 1. reb
2. und
3. joint
4. exa
5. sup
6. no relation
